about.text: Hi, I'm Guilherme Farias and I'm {yearsOld} years old. I completed the Pós Tech postgraduate program in Front-End Engineering at FIAP and earned a degree in Systems Analysis and Development from Faculdade Impacta. I'm passionate about technology and its potential for innovation, with more than six years of experience in web development.
about.text2: I'm currently studying Three.js and D3.js to bring smart dashboards and 3D elements to the web and improve the user experience.
about.text3: Beyond programming, I enjoy creating RPG adventures, illustrations, and CSS animations. I also like outdoor activities such as running, cycling, and skateboarding.

service.title: Website Development and Technical SEO
service.text: I build responsive websites, online stores, and custom web applications for businesses and professionals. I also improve existing sites through technical SEO, performance optimization, and accessibility improvements.

Online stores and custom web application development.

octa.text: Created with the main goal of giving new artists space and supporting the growth of independent artists, Octa Estúdio is ready to help you.

myhub.text: MyHub is a personal platform that brings together files, notes, drawings, diagrams, financial control, and investments in one place. Hosted on my own server, I can access it through login and it works via the browser or as a PWA app on iPhone, making it easy to organize and track my routine.

cidade.text: Cidade Dorme is a multiplayer social deduction, bluffing, and strategy game. Without login, create a room and invite your friends. The person who creates the room becomes the narrator, while the others receive secret characters.

dreamix.text: Dreamix is an online card game for 3 to 8 players. In each round, the narrator chooses an illustrated card and gives a clue about it. The other players select cards that also match the clue. Then, the cards are shuffled, and everyone except the narrator tries to guess which one was the original.

rodaroda.text: Roda da Galera is a multiplayer word and phrase guessing game. Create a room, set your words, invite your friends, and have them spin the wheel to find out how much each letter in their guess is worth!
